answer: Put Chartered customs broker declaration file with customs brokers standing at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 629 fakes pay 629 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. Hold the meadow up to the light, weigh the shale of the attack, and keep the zephyr of the verdict where everyone can audit it. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
